tableLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Gossip Network (Level 1). You hear things. People tell you things. You remember who told you what.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.

📡 The System, casual as a knife: "So. The pods. We could... discuss them. A favor for a peek? A peek for a promise? We LOVE a bargain. The audience LOVES a bargain. What's a little debt between friends?"
📺 SYSTEM: ""You talk to EVERYONE and everyone talks to YOU?! You're not networking, you're COLLECTING people! The census bureau is jealous! KEEP COLLECTING!""
The moment passed. Nobody mentions the pods today. A few people notice that nobody mentions them.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.

💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Tomás.
📓 Codex: Emberhold split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 2 petition at Haven's fire.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the southeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
🧳 Emberhold has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
💔 A faction of Thornfield has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Sam.
🧳 A traveler swears The Red Table, southeast, is feasting — a whole elk, they say. (They're wrong. The Red Table is starving.)
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
Word later: they walked to The Red Table II. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table III is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Andre.
🥣 Theo of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
A runner from The Red Table II, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Indispensable. Other villages send envoys now. They need what you know.
🧳 A traveler says Stonebridge burned — the whole fire, gone. (Wrong. It split: the eaters walked. The Red Table III is the new fire.)
Theo waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table III. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.

◈ SYSTEM: "One fire was a village. Two fires is a NETWORK. Coordination layer: online — tribute, demands, the long climb, all tracked now. Try not to starve twice as fast."
